en: Fixed the Claude apps gateway hiding Amazon Bedrock's "Input is too long." error, which left sessions failing every turn with "upstream rejected the request" instead of compacting
zh: 修复了 Claude 应用网关隐藏 Amazon Bedrock 的“Input is too long.”错误的问题；此前这会导致 session 每一轮都因“upstream rejected the request”失败，而无法进行上下文压缩
